name: Jamble
long_description:
Jamble is a live shopping marketplace for collectibles in Brazil. Collectors discover products, meet sellers and buy together in interactive live shows, from Pokémon and other trading cards to Hot Wheels and diecast miniatures.

Buyers see items live, ask questions and make offers in real time. Sellers turn their expertise and inventory into live storefronts, build an audience and grow a community of returning customers.

Jamble brings live video, chat, checkout, payments via PIX and cards, and tracked shipping into one app. Available on iOS and Android.

Explore Jamble: https://www.jamble.com/
one_liner: Live shopping for collectibles in Brazil

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
Jamble was founded in 2021 by Aymar Dumoulin, Louis de Jenlis and Jeremy Gozlan, three longtime friends with firsthand experience buying and selling collectibles and vintage fashion. The company joined Y Combinator's Summer 2022 batch.\
\
Jamble began as a fashion resale marketplace and evolved into live shopping. Today, the business is focused on Brazil and the communities around Pokémon, trading cards, diecast miniatures and other collectibles.

launches.title: Jamble - The future of fashion resale
launches.tagline: We’re creating a new way to buy and sell fashion with video & Live streaming
launches.body:
Hi there,

We’re Aymar, Jeremy and Louis and we’re excited to present Jamble!

Jamble is a secondhand fashion marketplace using the power of video & Live streaming.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65291&key=user_uploads/998576/7a357bf4-bbc5-4860-b499-636ce8f606e8)

### ✨ **Why video & Live in secondhand fashion?**

Secondhand clothing is a global phenomenon, growing 8x faster than the overall apparel market, and should overtake fast fashion by 2029.

However, C2C marketplaces have hardly been moving with the times. We want to leverage short-form video & Live streaming to create a new buyer & seller experience.

* Live streaming is a game changer in secondhand fashion. Connecting with an audience in real time, answering all questions at once and selling to the highest bidder is the most effective way to move inventories - way more than managing static listings for months. It is also a unique compelling experience for the buyer.
* Short videos have become one of the most powerful means for discovery in fashion. We developed a social Feed where our community can share inspiration, styling tips, outfits, etc. This is a place for users to find their next fashion ideas and creators to get known.

### 👋 **Meet the Jamble Team**

We’re 3 French founders 🇫🇷, we grew up in the same Parisian district and have a longstanding relationship together. We’re all experienced resellers - Aymar and Louis used to run an online vintage shop together while Jeremy is a crazy sneakerhead. We started in France in 2021 before relocating to the US.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65291&key=user_uploads/998576/fd6e0c77-e586-4688-ad49-32afe8e03af6)

### 📱**How can I try Jamble out?**

We launched a couple of month ago on iOS and you can download the App here 👉
